sub: Copy and adapt it in 6 parts

steps.title: Job title
points: Admin Intern
Add length and place, e.g. 12 weeks, Manchester
Skip vague titles like "Office Hero"
steps.tip: Use the words students type into job boards.

steps.title: About the role
points: Two or three lines on the team
What the intern will help you achieve
Who they will report to
steps.tip: Write it for the reader: what will they learn and do?

steps.title: Key tasks
points: Manage the team diary and meeting rooms
Keep records and spreadsheets up to date
Draft emails, minutes and simple reports
Support events and office projects
steps.tip: List 4 to 6 real tasks so applicants can picture the day.

steps.title: Skills you need
points: Organised, with an eye for detail
Confident with Excel or Google Sheets
Clear written English
Friendly on the phone and by email
steps.tip: Split must-haves from nice-to-haves so good people still apply.

steps.title: Practical details
points: Start date and length
Hours and working pattern
Location: office, hybrid or remote
Who can apply, e.g. students or recent graduates
steps.tip: Answer the obvious questions upfront and save a pile of emails.

steps.title: How to apply
points: Ask for a CV and a short cover note
Give a closing date
Say when they will hear back
Offer a contact for adjustments
steps.tip: A short, simple application is kinder to applicants and quicker for you.
